#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int ans = 0;
    regex pattern("(.)\\1*");
    smatch match;
    string::const_iterator it = s.begin();
    while (regex_search(it, s.end(), match, pattern)) {
        if ((match.str().length() & 1) == 0)
            ans++;
        it = match.suffix().first;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
